title: Solo
summary: SO'LO, noun [Latin solus, alone.] A tune, air or strain to be played by a single instrument, or sung by a single voice. SOLOMON'S LEAF, noun A plant. SOLOMON'S SEAL, noun A plant of the genus Convalla

inlines.v: SO'LO, noun [Latin solus, alone.] A tune, air or strain to be played by a single instrument, or sung by a single voice. SOLOMON'S LEAF, noun A plant. SOLOMON'S SEAL, noun A plant of the genus Convallaria, and another of the genus Uvularia.
